root_causes: Graphify's full virtualenv bin directory exposed the unintended graphify-mcp entrypoint on the model PATH.
Corrected profile IDs all ended in -v1, while artifact_profile_label selected only the final slug; this collapsed every treatment session ID to the shared v1 prefix.
fixes: Expose only a lane-private graphify symlink directory; keep the transitive graphify-mcp entrypoint off PATH.
Bind every corrected profile to an explicit unique artifact label and exclude immutable already-executed protocols from launch selection.
repair_note.shared_runner_protocol_impact: All 39 launch protocols were regenerated; the three immutable TokenJuice protocols remain referenced only by their accepted sessions.
